prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Monochrome Signal: page #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #494949, secondary surface #E8E8E8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Bagnard and reading text in Cotham Sans; characterful display serif with understated body. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Use body 16px, heading 80px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
